name: Afikpo

routes.outcome: Official Ebonyi State Lands and Survey ministry page was reachable and identifies the state ministry/custodian. It provides ministry information but no public parcel layer, schema, CRS, or geometry response.
Official-state-branded Ebonyi Ministry of Lands and Survey portal was reachable. It advertises property searches, beacon lookup, land registration, land allocation, and statistics.

Public property-search instructions were reachable. The search form requires a security number and serial number after payment; no credentials, payment, protected request, owner, address, title, or personal fields were requested.

Public beacon-lookup instructions were reachable and state that the coordinate register contains approved property beacon coordinates. The form requires a username and password; no login or protected request was attempted.
Public C-of-O data search returned HTTP 200 and rendered a search-result page for Afikpo, but no Afikpo parcel geometry or safe native parcel identity was exposed in the response.

National Office of the Surveyor-General of the Federation site was reachable and describes general mapping, coordinates, and cadastral-survey services. It was kept distinct from the Ebonyi local/state custodian and no parcel response was requested.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: No safe anonymous parcel geometry endpoint was exposed after first-party discovery and public-shell inspection; no ID-plus-geometry request was made.

polygon geometry if later exposed anonymously

qualification.reason: Ebonyi local/state land and survey custody and a public land-management portal are evidenced, but no safe anonymous native-ID polygon response, schema, CRS, or independent adapter behavior was exposed. Runtime qualification remains a separate serial review.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [5.88241950419596, 7.94495489106671] was preserved in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate shift or parcel-hit forcing was attempted.
The property-search and beacon routes are payment/security-number or login-oriented; no protected access, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or private token was used.
A zero exact-point hit, public C-of-O search result without geometry, or absence of an anonymous endpoint is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
The national OSGOF route was kept distinct from the Ebonyi local/state custodian and was not treated as an Afikpo parcel service.
No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe anonymous native ID-plus-geometry response was available.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, certificate/title, or personal fields were requested or retained.
Request captures and scratch evidence belong under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/8265/.
uncertainty: Ebonyi State publicly evidences land and survey administration and a digital portal with property, beacon, registration, allocation, and C-of-O functions. Public coverage of Afikpo, cadastral digitization extent, anonymous viewer/API availability, schema, CRS, native identity, update cadence, licensing, and runtime adapter behavior remain unverified. No citywide absence inference is made.
